summary: Worcester County, MA lookout site on Wood Hill; the register describes a wooden tower and files it among former sites. No build date, staffing or current condition found.

facts.status_note: Listed as a former lookout site; no source we read says what, if anything, remains on Wood Hill.

events.note: Registered September 3, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

the tower on the site was wooden

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the register page is the only source with content. The NHLR has no page at the guessed URL (404), and the Wikipedia article for Webster has no tower mention. The brief's status 'gone' rests on the register's 'former' heading; no source says when or how the tower came down, so no status fact is set. Coordinates and 279 m elevation in the brief match the register. Worth an editor check against Worcester County or Webster town histories.
